product_overview: Bharat PulseLink is a clinical intelligence dashboard that automates patient triage using AI, combines environmental and epidemic data, and provides EHR-ready reports and live monitoring to help clinical teams prioritize and allocate resources faster.
core_goals: Provide AI-driven patient triage with clear risk categories and confidence scoring
Enable secure user authentication and onboarding flow with mandatory API configuration for live data
Deliver real-time environmental (pollution/weather) and epidemic intelligence to anticipate demand surges
Produce instant, shareable EHR reports (PDF) and persist triage data for clinical review
Fallback to simulated/local data when external services are unavailable for reliable demos

features.name: User Login
features.description: Allow clinicians and staff to sign in via email/password or Google OAuth; support sign-up and ensure first-time users complete mandatory API setup after account creation.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill email input -> Fill password input -> Click "Sign In" button -> Redirected to /dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Click "Sign in with Google" button -> Complete Google OAuth consent -> Redirected to /dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Toggle between Sign In and Sign Up modes -> Fill email input -> Fill password input -> Click "Sign Up" button -> Redirected to /setup
Navigate to /login -> Fill email input -> Fill password input -> Click "Sign In" button -> See authentication error message "Invalid credentials" -> Remain on /login

features.name: API Setup
features.description: Collect and save required third-party API keys (Gemini, Google Maps, Weather/OpenWeather, WAQI/News) so the dashboard can switch from simulated to live data streams.
user_flows: Navigate to /setup -> Click "Configure API Keys" button -> Fill Gemini API Key -> Fill Google Maps API Key -> Fill Weather API Key -> Click "Save All Configuration" button -> See success confirmation message -> Dashboard data switches to live streams on /dashboard
Navigate to /setup -> Click "Configure API Keys" button -> Fill Gemini API Key only -> Click "Save All Configuration" button -> See validation error "Missing required API keys" -> Remain on /setup
Navigate to /setup -> Click "Configure API Keys" button -> Fill all keys -> Click "Save All Configuration" button -> Network request fails -> See network error toast -> Remain on /setup

features.name: Patient Triage
features.description: Capture patient demographics, symptoms, images and vitals, run the AI analysis to produce a risk category (Low/Medium/High) with confidence and suggested department allocation; allow PDF report generation and saving to EHR.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Fill patient name -> Fill age -> Fill gender -> List symptoms -> Take/upload photo or record vitals -> Click "Run AI Triage Analysis" -> See triage results with risk category and confidence score

Navigate to /dashboard -> Fill patient name -> Fill age -> Fill gender -> List symptoms -> Take/upload photo or record vitals -> Click "Run AI Triage Analysis" -> Click "Generate PDF Report" -> See downloadable PDF of the assessment
Navigate to /dashboard -> Fill patient name -> Leave symptoms empty -> Click "Run AI Triage Analysis" -> See validation error "Symptoms required" -> Remain on triage form
Navigate to /dashboard -> Fill patient name -> Fill age -> Fill gender -> Attempt to upload unsupported file type -> See upload error message "Unsupported file format" -> Remain on triage form

features.name: Pollution Monitor
features.description: Display real-time air quality (AQI) and historical trends on the dashboard using WAQI/OpenWeather data; show simulated data when live feeds are unavailable.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Open Pollution Monitor panel -> See current AQI value and primary pollutant (observation) -> See trend chart updating over time
Navigate to /dashboard -> Open Pollution Monitor panel -> Click a data point on the trend chart -> See detail tooltip with timestamp and value
Navigate to /dashboard -> Open Pollution Monitor panel -> Live API unreachable -> See banner "Live data unavailable — showing simulated data" -> See AQI values labeled as simulated
Navigate to /dashboard -> Open Pollution Monitor panel -> Saved API key missing -> See prompt linking to /setup to configure WAQI/OpenWeather API key

features.name: Epidemic Tracker
features.description: Aggregate health alerts and news to surface outbreak warnings, predicted trends and recommended operational actions so administrators can plan staffing and resources.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Open Epidemic Tracker -> See list of current outbreak alerts with severity tags -> Click an alert -> See alert details and predicted trend
Navigate to /dashboard -> Open Epidemic Tracker -> See recommended actions for a selected alert (observation) -> Click "View affected regions" -> See map detail
Navigate to /dashboard -> Open Epidemic Tracker -> No external alerts returned -> See message "No alerts available" -> Click "Refresh" -> See still no alerts
Navigate to /dashboard -> Open Epidemic Tracker -> News API rate-limited -> See warning "Limited data - using cached results" -> See older/cached alert list
